results.summary: The study measured functional dispersion, sociality, and nest location traits across one hundred eleven bee species collected using four different sampling methods (elevated bowl traps, ground-level bowl traps, Malaise traps, and vane traps). The measurements covered many species, with specific attention paid to the representation of certain genera like Lasioglossum, Bombus, and Melissodes across these methods. The study measured the relationship between different sampling methods (ground-level bowl traps, elevated bowl traps, Malaise traps, and vane traps) and various traits of collected bees
